t_advice_summary_textbox.text: They seemed to contradict themselves by saying they favoured the left side but then decided that the colour assignment was random.

vb_textbox.text: I don't think that the left or right side score more than each other and the points were related to the colour of the gnomes instead. I'm not sure if each colour scored more when it was on a specific side but I think the better scoring colours changed throughout the game.
